subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `sessions.activity` RPC, `session.activity` event, and task/tool plugin hooks as the canonical public activity contract, or should those surfaces wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to be settled first?
rationale: The diff defines new public Gateway/protocol/plugin SDK semantics, and current related issues show the activity, attention, stale-run, and child-rollup contract is still a maintainer-owned product/API decision.

options.title: Align Behind Canonical Contract
options.body: Settle the Gateway activity schema in the canonical issue, then update this PR or a replacement to match that contract and keep only the accepted public surfaces.

options.title: Accept This Contract Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can approve this RPC/event/hook shape after fixing the concrete scoping and raw-text defects and documenting the upgrade implications.

options.title: Pause Or Close This Branch
options.body: If the branch is too far from the desired contract, keep the canonical issue open and ask for a narrower replacement after the API direction is clear.

recommendation.title: Align Behind Canonical Contract
recommendation.body: Settle the Gateway activity schema in the canonical issue, then update this PR or a replacement to match that contract and keep only the accepted public surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical per-session activity contract issue and has the strongest routing signal for the Gateway/protocol decision.
